scripts.build: node scripts/generate-character-assets.mjs && node scripts/generate-gui-assets.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test: node scripts/generate-character-assets.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-gui-assets.mjs --check && vitest run
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/gui-browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/interactions-browser.mjs && node scripts/files-browser.mjs
